column10: Headquartered in Montgomery County (Dayton). Dockets via Montgomery County Clerk of Courts and other district county clerks.

Third District covers 17 counties (Allen, Auglaize, Crawford, Defiance, Hancock, Hardin, Henry, Logan, Marion, Mercer, Paulding, Putnam, Seneca, Shelby, Union, Van Wert, Wyandot). Each county Clerk of Common Pleas is also clerk of the Court of Appeals for cases originating there. Docket access varies by county; the court website itself does not provide unified docket search.

Fourth District covers 14 counties (Adams, Athens, Gallia, Highland, Hocking, Jackson, Lawrence, Meigs, Pickaway, Pike, Ross, Scioto, Vinton, Washington). No unified docket portal on court website; dockets are at each county clerk's site.

Fifth District covers 15 counties (Ashland, Coshocton, Delaware, Fairfield, Guernsey, Holmes, Knox, Licking, Morgan, Morrow, Muskingum, Perry, Richland, Stark, Tuscarawas). Headquartered in Stark County. No unified docket portal; each county clerk maintains its own case database.
Stark County (Canton) Clerk of Courts eServices - hosts appellate cases originating in Stark County.
Sixth District covers Erie, Fulton, Huron, Lucas, Ottawa, Sandusky, Williams, and Wood counties. Headquartered in Toledo (Lucas County).
Lucas County Clerk online dockets - hosts 6th District Court of Appeals case search.
Seventh District covers Belmont, Carroll, Columbiana, Harrison, Jefferson, Mahoning, Monroe, and Noble counties. Headquartered in Youngstown.
Mahoning County Clerk of Courts case search - hosts 7th District cases originating in Mahoning County.
Eighth District covers only Cuyahoga County (Cleveland). Court has its own website and docket access via county clerk.
Cuyahoga County Clerk of Courts online docket.
Ninth District covers Lorain, Medina, Summit, and Wayne counties. Court website links to each county clerk's docket page.
Summit County (Akron) Clerk of Courts - hosts the bulk of 9th District appellate cases.
Tenth District covers only Franklin County (Columbus). Also hears appeals from the Ohio Court of Claims.
Franklin County Clerk of Courts case information online.
Eleventh District covers Ashtabula, Geauga, Lake, Portage, and Trumbull counties. Court website links to each county clerk's docket.
Trumbull County Clerk of Courts eServices - hosts 11th District cases originating in Trumbull County.

Twelfth District covers Brown, Butler, Clermont, Clinton, Fayette, Madison, Preble, and Warren counties. Headquartered in Middletown (Butler County). No unified docket portal; cases are accessed via each county clerk's site.
Butler County Clerk of Courts public access - hosts 12th District cases originating in Butler County.
OJCIN OnLine - subscription based ($-fee). Limited free public access via separate appellate docket page.
